annotations.title: What electric cars cost per km in Switzerland (EV cost comparison)

description: Electric cars offered in Switzerland ranked by total cost in CHF per km (depreciation, capital, tax, insurance, tyres and service, energy, wallbox, import fees, monthly fees), across buying new or used, importing from Germany, leasing and subscriptions, from the EV cost comparison (ev.zzd.ch, free, by zzd). Optional driving profile. The offers are a dated, hand-collected snapshot, not live prices; the model is calibrated for canton Aargau. The result links the comparison page.

acquisitionType.description: How the car is obtained. Without it, all ways are ranked.

homeElectricityChfPerKwh.description: Home electricity price in CHF per kWh.

publicChargingChfPerKwh.description: Public charging price in CHF per kWh.
